features.featureTitle: Replace all 8 service category card images in ServiceCategoryGrid component with real professional service photos: pest control technician spraying house, carpenter working on furniture, professional home cleaning in action, electrician fixing switch/wiring, AC technician servicing air conditioning unit, washing machine/fridge repair technician working, plumber fixing sink/pipe, painter rolling paint on wall. Use uploaded images if available, otherwise generate or select high-quality stock photos. Ensure each category has a distinct, realistic, service-relevant image with object-fit: cover, consistent height, rounded corners, and no cartoons, illustrations, grey placeholders, or broken images.

Change global background theme from plain white to premium subtle gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f8fb 0%, #eef3f9 50%, #f1f5f9 100%) applied to body element across all pages (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews). Keep all cards white with soft shadows. Do not change button colors, navbar colors, or text colors. Maintain professional clean service-app style.

Fix service dropdown mobile scrolling issue on Booking page and Reviews page by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain to the dropdown menu element. Set z-index: 9999 on dropdown to ensure it appears above all other elements. Prevent page body scroll when dropdown is open on mobile devices.

Add smooth hover lift effect to all service cards with transform: translateY(-6px), transition: 0.3s ease, and enhanced soft shadow on hover. Keep existing card colors and text styling unchanged. Apply this effect to service cards on Services page and Pricing page.

Verify and ensure booking form on Booking page works correctly: form should open WhatsApp at https://wa.me/918884447229 with pre-filled message containing Name, Phone, Service, Address, and Date/Message fields. Verify form submission stores booking data in Motoko backend and email notifications remain active. Do not change form layout or styling.

Optimize all service and category images for faster loading by compressing image files and implementing lazy loading for service card images on Services page and Pricing page. Ensure images maintain quality while reducing file size.
